source_claims.quote: a deity with the body of a monkey; a companion of the deity Rama and an exemplar of self-discipline and devotion.

statement.id: Hanuman adalah dewa bertubuh kera, pendamping Rama, dan teladan bakti.
statement.en: Hanuman is a monkey-bodied deity, Rama's companion, and an exemplar of devotion.

source_claims.quote: One of the princes in the Mahabharat is also a son of the Wind God and it is to him that Hanuman makes his only appearance in this epic. This prince, named Bhima, was as mighty as the wind ... he could not move even a whisker of the tail. It transpired that the monkey was none other than Hanuman, the mightiest being on earth.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Bhima tak mampu menggeser sehelai pun ekor seekor kera tua yang ternyata adalah Hanuman, makhluk terkuat di bumi.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Bhima cannot move even a whisker of an old monkey's tail; the monkey turns out to be Hanuman, the mightiest being on earth.

source_claims.quote: He is most often depicted with his favourite weapon, the mace. He is also often depicted as flying across the skies, one hand holding aloft the mountain of herbs and the other a mace.

statement.id: Hanuman paling sering digambarkan dengan senjata kesayangannya, gada, dan juga sering digambarkan terbang di langit dengan satu tangan mengangkat gunung ramuan dan tangan lain memegang gada.
statement.en: Hanuman is most often depicted with his favourite weapon, the mace, and often flying across the sky with one hand holding up the mountain of herbs and the other a mace.

source_claims.quote: He is the one who flies across the oceans (he is Wind's child), locates the exact place where Sita is imprisoned and brings this information back to Rama.

statement.id: Hanuman terbang menyeberangi lautan untuk menemukan Sita dan membawa kabar kepada Rama.
statement.en: Hanuman flies over the sea to locate Sita and report back to Rama.

source_claims.quote: Being unable to identify the exact four herbs that the physician had described, Hanuman uproots the entire mountain and carries it back to the battlefield.

statement.id: Ketika tidak bisa mengenali ramuan penyembuh, Hanuman membawa seluruh gunung ke medan perang.
statement.en: Unable to identify the healing herbs, Hanuman carries the whole mountain to the battlefield.

source_claims.quote: The shadow on the ocean cast By his vast form, as on he passed, Flew like a ship before the gale When the strong breeze has filled the sail, And where his course the Vánar held The sea beneath him raged and swelled.

statement.id: Bayangan tubuh raksasa Hanumán di atas samudra meluncur seperti kapal diterpa angin, dan laut di bawah jalurnya bergolak serta menggelembung.
statement.en: The shadow of Hanumán's vast form on the ocean flew like a ship before the gale, and the sea beneath his course raged and swelled.

source_claims.quote: and stood before their joyous eyes Dilated in gigantic size.

statement.id: Hanumán, jiwanya terdorong untuk berupaya keras, berdiri di depan mata mereka yang bersukacita dengan tubuh membesar hingga ukuran raksasa.
statement.en: Hanumán, his soul stirred to vigorous effort, stood before their joyous eyes dilated in gigantic size.

source_claims.quote: The catch? The battle is raging on in Lanka, across the southernmost tip of the country, while the Himalayas are far up north, and the herbs are needed within the next few hours, before the new day dawns. Hanuman leaps up into the air, flies northwards at lightning speed, and alights atop the Himalayas.

statement.id: Pertempuran berkecamuk di Lanka sementara Himalaya jauh di utara, dan ramuan dibutuhkan sebelum fajar; Hanuman melompat ke udara, terbang ke utara secepat kilat, dan mendarat di puncak Himalaya.
statement.en: The battle rages in Lanka while the Himalayas are far to the north and the herbs are needed before dawn; Hanuman leaps into the air, flies north at lightning speed and alights atop the Himalayas.
